versions.changelog:
VGMdb Concerts 2.1.4

- Plugin version: 2.1.4.0
- Target Jellyfin ABI: 12.1.0.0
- Upstream commit: a633b1bd98e0a9774c833632d74111bb43664eba
- Independent plugin GUID: 553a22b2-1600-47c1-99e7-367c69ce0c09

This standalone build registers Movie-related VGMdb providers plus metadata and image providers restricted to generated concert collections. It does not register Artist/MusicAlbum providers and can coexist with Jellyfin's official VGMdb music plugin.
